topics.title: Stellarator holds plasma for record 40 minutes
topics.summary: A research stellarator kept a stable plasma going for 40 minutes — four times its previous best — thanks to a new tungsten wall coating. Physicists say it's a real but incremental step; net energy gain is still years off.
topics.detail: The lab credited the tungsten wall coating for shedding less material into the plasma, which helped maintain stability. Two outside physicists called it a genuine but modest advance, emphasizing that fusion energy remains a long game. The lab is planning a spring 2027 campaign aiming for one-hour runs at higher density, according to the French report.

sources.title: Test stellarator holds plasma for a record 40 minutes
Le stellarator d'essai bat son record de durée

topics.new_development: The council has now scheduled a formal vote on a 10-year moratorium for 12 November, a concrete step beyond the earlier talks.
topics.title: Seabed body schedules vote on mining moratorium
topics.summary: An international seabed council agreed to vote on a 10-year moratorium on commercial deep-sea mining at its November session. Twelve member states back the pause, but two companies with exploration contracts say it would breach existing agreements.
topics.detail: The published agenda puts the moratorium vote on 12 November, requiring a two-thirds majority to pass. Twelve member states support the pause, while two companies holding exploration contracts argue a moratorium would violate their existing agreements. This is a significant escalation from the earlier talks, moving from discussion to a concrete vote.

sources.title: Seabed authority schedules a vote on a mining moratorium
Council agenda lists the moratorium for 12 November

topics.title: Chess federation trials shorter youth time controls
topics.summary: A national chess federation will test 45-minute games with a 10-second increment at three youth events this winter, citing shorter attention spans and travel costs. Coaches are split on the change.
topics.detail: The trial aims to address shorter attention spans and reduce travel costs for young players. Coaches quoted in the report were divided, with some welcoming the faster format and others concerned about its impact on deep play. The federation will evaluate results after the three events.

sources.title: Chess federation tests a shorter time control for youth events

topics.title: Regional chess open draws record field of 900
topics.summary: A regional open chess tournament drew 900 players, its largest field since it began in 1998. Organizers had to add a second playing hall to accommodate the crowd.
topics.detail: The record turnout marks a significant milestone for the event, which has grown steadily over nearly three decades. Organizers added a second playing hall to handle the influx of participants. No further details on winners or standout games were provided in the report.

sources.title: Regional chess open draws a record field of 900
